body_html:
The Global Accord mesh back tilter brings award-winning, refined design to the desks that matter most. Its breathable mesh back promotes airflow and gently follows the natural curve of the spine, while polished aluminum arms and a sling-style profile give boardrooms and private offices a confident, contemporary presence. Designed by Zooey Chu, it is built for people who sit through long working days and expect both comfort and polish.

Features

  • Breathable mesh back promotes airflow and supports the natural curve of the spine to reduce fatigue
  • Sling-style back contours to evenly support the back and shoulders
  • Polished aluminum arms finished with soft, warm urethane arm caps
  • Pneumatic seat-height adjustment for a comfortable fit at any desk
  • Tilt-tension adjustment and multiple-position tilt-lock control
  • Over 20 Vue mesh colours, with seat upholstery in fabric, vinyl, or fine Italian leather

Specifications

High back model measuring 25"W x 25"D x 42.5"H with pneumatic seat-height adjustment, rated for users up to 300 lbs and tested to exceed ANSI/BIFMA standards. Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group and backed by a limited lifetime warranty on the frame and structural components, 12 years on control mechanisms, and 5 years on upholstery, foam and mesh.

Family-owned since 1964 and based at 296 George St N, Peterborough ON, Brant Business Interiors is an OECM-eligible supplier, so Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote on the Global Accord mesh back tilter or call 1-800-835-9565.
